title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
overview: The AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner course is designed for individuals seeking to validate their knowledge of AWS Cloud fundamentals. This entry-level course provides an overview of AWS services, cloud concepts, and best practices, and prepares participants for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam.
audience: Individuals new to the AWS Cloud and seeking to gain foundational knowledge.
Non-technical professionals, such as sales, marketing, and finance teams, who interact with AWS.
IT professionals looking for a basic understanding of AWS Cloud concepts and services.
Anyone preparing for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner certification exam.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Comprehensive explanations of AWS Cloud concepts and services.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises to familiarize participants with AWS management tools.
Case Studies: Real-world examples to understand cloud solutions and best practices.
Group Discussions: Collaborative sessions to explore AWS services and their applications.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and exam readiness.
competencies: AWS Cloud basics and core services
AWS management tools and best practices
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a foundational understanding of AWS Cloud concepts and services.
To prepare participants for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam.
To familiarize learners with AWS pricing, billing, and support options.
To introduce key AWS services and their use cases.
To explain AWS security and compliance basics.

outline.title: 1. Introduction to Cloud Computing and AWS
